Subject: LumenAI tranche request + SOW attached (DL-7834)

Vanessa / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — LumenAI is moving quickly and we want to lock the committed capacity cadence for the dedicated pool tied to DL-7834. Attached is our final SOW (LumenAI_Final_SOW.pdf) and a high-level run rate profile. We need to align two things before we finalize the contract:

1) A tranche/reserve ladder that lets us secure incremental SKUs across Q4 → Q1 deliver windows (we're asking for an initial 30% deposit to reserve the first tranche).
2) A single harmonized OEM quote that reflects staged delivery (partial shipments allowed) so we can match hardware receipts to our internal onboarding sprints.

Questions for Redwood:
- Does Redwood support a tranche-release schedule (e.g., 30/30/40 across 3 windows) that ties directly to an invoice schedule?
- Can Redwood coordinate a single OEM quote that bundles Northstar SKUs + any logistics premiums so we avoid multiple invoices?

We looped in CloudMark to confirm available cloud fallback capacity and Northstar to get a consolidated quote. Ideally we'd get a harmonized quote + proposed tranche schedule by end of week so legal can finish the SOW.

Attachments: LumenAI_Final_SOW.pdf (pdf)

Next steps: will you confirm available cadence options and whether Redwood can accept a deposit to prioritize allocation with Northstar?

Appreciate it,
Sally Perez
Head of Cloud Ops, LumenAI
Procurement: +1 415 555 0189

Sally — thanks for the SOW and the clear ask. High level: yes, we can support tranche-based reservations, but a few guardrails and vendor confirmations are required before we sign off. Proposed approach from our side:

- Tranche cadence options: 25/25/25/25 monthly release, 30/30/40 over three windows, or milestone-based releases tied to onboarding dates in the SOW. We prefer the milestone-based approach for predictable invoicing.
- Deposit and allocation: Redwood can accept a deposit that we push to OEM priority allocation, but we need Northstar to confirm what deposit percentage triggers priority and whether partial shipments are allowed.
- One harmonized quote: we can consolidate logistics and OEM fees into a single Redwood-issued quote if Northstar provides a line-item export (SKU + lead time + per-unit freight).

Can Northstar confirm lead times per SKU and whether they support split deliveries? Can CloudMark confirm the fallback pool and minimum activation notice?

If we get vendor confirmations today/Thursday we can circulate an internal procurement window and lock the invoice cadence for legal to finalize the SOW next week.

Thanks — V.

Vanessa / Sally / vendors — internal procurement POV and contingency plan below.

Summary: Redwood can coordinate tranche reservations and issue a single consolidated quote, but we need documented lead times and a deposit to push Northstar into a priority lane. If Northstar cannot commit to split shipments, we'll propose a hybrid: Redwood holds a short-term cloud reserve with CloudMark (activation within 7 business days) to smooth onboarding while hardware ships.

Proposed procurement playbook:
- Deposit: 25% of committed value to secure priority allocation. Deposit triggers a written allocation confirmation from Northstar within 10 business days.
- Tranche release: milestone-based (matching SOW on-ramps). Each tranche release requires a PO that triggers invoicing for that tranche.
- Lead time penalty clause: if OEM misses agreed lead time by more than 2 weeks, Redwood may invoice a credit against the next tranche (amount to be negotiated).
- Fallback: CloudMark capacity can be held for up to 30 days with a week notice; see attached CloudMark_capacity_schedule.xlsx for activation windows.

Attachments: CloudMark_capacity_schedule.xlsx (xlsx)

Action items for vendors:
- Northstar: provide updated quote with per-SKU lead times and confirm partial shipment support + deposit threshold.
- CloudMark: confirm minimum activation notice and confirm cancellation/credit terms.

If vendors can return confirmations by EOD Friday (Oct 3) we can circulate the consolidated quote and an updated SOW to legal next week.

Jonas Weber
Head of Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
